# Security Requirements Quality Checklist: Secure Document Sharing

**Purpose**: Review the completeness, clarity, consistency, and measurability of the feature's security and privacy requirements.
**Created**: 2026-10-19
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist was generated by `/speckit-checklist` based on feature context and security requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

## Authorization and Identity

- [ ] CHK001 - Are the authorization requirements explicit about checking the current user, company membership, document, and requested action on every document operation? [Clarity, Spec §FR-003]
- [ ] CHK002 - Are the permitted actions and decision rules for read, edit, grant, revoke, organize, delete, upload, and download distinguished clearly enough to prevent role-based access from being mistaken for a document grant? [Completeness, Spec §FR-002–FR-005]
- [ ] CHK003 - Is the distinction between administrator capability and owner/viewer document roles consistent across the role requirements, member-management scenarios, and owner-access rules? [Consistency, Spec §FR-002, Spec §FR-004, Spec §FR-017]
- [ ] CHK004 - Are cross-company access, unknown roles, missing grants, inactive members, and unknown document states all explicitly covered by fail-closed requirements? [Coverage, Spec §FR-001, Spec §FR-003, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK005 - Is the requirement for authorization regression tests specific about negative cases and checks that must fail when a guard is removed? [Clarity, Spec §FR-015]
- [ ] CHK006 - Are sign-in, invitation acceptance, account deactivation, and session termination requirements sufficiently defined to establish when a member is authenticated and when access ends? [Completeness, Spec §FR-001–FR-002, Spec §Edge Cases]

## Document Privacy and File Handling

- [ ] CHK007 - Are the 404 rules consistently defined for unreadable documents across detail views, downloads, edits, searches, and other document identifiers? [Consistency, Spec §FR-007, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK008 - Do the requirements define which document metadata may appear in search results and derived counts without exposing information about unreadable documents? [Clarity, Spec §FR-011]
- [ ] CHK009 - Are private file delivery and the prohibition on bypassing request-time authorization explicit for every way document bytes could be retrieved? [Completeness, Spec §FR-003, Spec §FR-007, Gap]
- [ ] CHK010 - Are upload format, size, content-validation, malformed-file, and filename-handling requirements objective enough to distinguish acceptable from rejected uploads? [Measurability, Spec §FR-010]
- [ ] CHK011 - Are the consequences and audit behavior for rejected, partially stored, or interrupted uploads specified without leaving a document or file accessible? [Coverage, Spec §FR-008, Spec §FR-010, Gap]
- [ ] CHK012 - Are requirements defined for protecting uploaded file contents and sensitive document metadata at rest and during transfer? [Completeness, Gap]
- [ ] CHK013 - Are document deletion, physical file cleanup, backup copies, and any retention period described consistently enough to establish when deleted content is no longer recoverable? [Clarity, Spec §FR-005, Assumption]

## Audit Integrity and Monitoring

- [ ] CHK014 - Does the audit scope enumerate all allowed and refused security-sensitive actions, including authentication, membership changes, lease activity, and document operations? [Completeness, Spec §FR-008]
- [ ] CHK015 - Are audit ordering and failure semantics explicit for both successful operations and denials when an audit event cannot be persisted? [Clarity, Spec §FR-008, Spec §FR-009, Gap]
- [ ] CHK016 - Are append-only and tamper-evident requirements distinguishable from an absolute claim that audit history cannot be changed by privileged infrastructure operators? [Clarity, Spec §FR-009, Assumption]
- [ ] CHK017 - Are the information permitted in audit events and the information that must never be recorded defined to minimize exposure of personal data, credentials, and document contents? [Completeness, Spec §FR-008, Gap]
- [ ] CHK018 - Is the suspicious-activity threshold unambiguous about the counted event types, user identity, time window, and whether the window is rolling? [Clarity, Spec §FR-013]
- [ ] CHK019 - Are requirements for audit retention, authorized review, export, and investigation of suspicious activity defined or explicitly deferred? [Completeness, Spec §FR-012–FR-013, Assumption]

## Administrative and Optional AI Access

- [ ] CHK020 - Are administrator activity-view permissions limited consistently to company-scoped event metadata without implying document-content access? [Consistency, Spec §FR-002, Spec §FR-012]
- [ ] CHK021 - Are self-role-change restrictions, allowed administrator role changes, and the required audit of refused attempts specified without conflicting role terminology? [Clarity, Spec §FR-002, Spec §FR-017]
- [ ] CHK022 - Are the data sources, data exclusions, and processing boundaries for optional access suggestions explicit and consistent with the prohibition on external AI processing? [Consistency, Spec §FR-014, Spec §Assumptions]
- [ ] CHK023 - Are authorization and audit requirements for confirming an AI-suggested grant equivalent to those for an ordinary owner-initiated grant? [Coverage, Spec §FR-003, Spec §FR-008, Spec §FR-014]

## Non-Functional Security Requirements and Assumptions

- [ ] CHK024 - Are HTTPS, secure session handling, and protection of authentication credentials stated as verifiable product security requirements rather than only as deployment design choices? [Completeness, Plan §Technical Context, Gap]
- [ ] CHK025 - Are security-relevant operational failure and recovery expectations defined for database unavailability, audit-chain verification failure, and private-storage failure? [Coverage, Plan §Constitution Check, Gap]
- [ ] CHK026 - Are the security assumptions about one-company membership, invitation lifetime, document retention, and deployment trust boundaries explicit and validated by an owner? [Assumption, Spec §Assumptions]
- [ ] CHK027 - Are requirements for limiting repeated authentication or access attempts and responding to abusive request rates defined or explicitly excluded? [Coverage, Spec §FR-013, Gap]
- [ ] CHK028 - Are security acceptance criteria objectively measurable for each critical access boundary, including denied access, immediate revocation, private file delivery, and audit-before-response behavior? [Measurability, Spec §Success Criteria]

## Notes

- Mark items `[x]` only after review confirms the requirement-quality criterion is satisfied.
- Leave items unchecked when they still require clarification, correction, or reviewer evaluation.
- `/speckit-implement` reads checklist checkbox state but does not modify markers.
- `checklists/requirements.md` has a separate built-in lifecycle maintained by `/speckit-specify` and `/speckit-clarify`.
- Items evaluate what the requirements say, not whether implementation or tests pass.
- Items are numbered sequentially for easy reference.
